default.description: Local shell capabilities: the fallback page runs with no plugin permissions; the daemon UI is remote content granted nothing.

proxy.description: IPC for the bundled UI's connection picker (AC5): list/add/remove/select a daemon connection (by URL or, via connections_add_relay, a relay pairing URL), read the current one, and open an http(s) link in the OS browser. No command exposes relay key material. Scoped to the loopback proxy origin only -- the daemon/relay content served through it never gets these commands.
